headline: Northland Power secures PLN 500 million for two energy storage facilities in Poland
summary: Northland Power has secured financing of about PLN 500 million for two energy storage facilities under construction in Poland. The projects have a combined capacity of 1.2 GWh and 300 MW of power.
why: Northland Power is a Toronto-based independent power producer developing renewable and storage assets across Europe and North America. Battery storage helps grid balancing as renewables expand.
